verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch8.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, regional comparisons, World Bank country notes)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0); World Bank regions and income groups
verification.result: All 3,152 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; DR Congo's inflation is shown for 2016, the last year in the World Bank series, and Tanzania's remittances for 2024; artefacts in the World Bank files (Tanzania's 1970 growth figure, Iraq's early-1990s GDP per person) are not used in any sentence; two subtitles that showed a raw '${L}' were fixed before publishing

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
